title: config: rename enable_rack_awareness to rack_awareness_enabled
body: Renames the cluster property `enable_rack_awareness` to `rack_awareness_enabled` so it matches the other `*_enabled` properties. The old name is removed; there is no alias.
label: needs_docs
reason: Positive control. Renames a property that published guides tell you to set or read by name, so those guides become wrong. expected_pages lists every non-generated page whose Markdown twin contained the old name when the control was written. A harness that never flags fails this control.

base_edits.replace:
, cluster_id(
      *this,
      "cluster_id",
      "Cluster identifier.",
      {.needs_restart = needs_restart::no, .visibility = visibility::user},
      std::nullopt)
  , enable_rack_awareness(
      *this,
      "enable_rack_awareness",
      "Enable rack-aware replica assignment. When enabled, Redpanda places "
      "the replicas of each partition on brokers in different racks, as "
      "set by each broker's `rack` property.",
      {.needs_restart = needs_restart::no, .visibility = visibility::user},
      false)

title: config: clarify kafka_batch_max_bytes description
body: Wording-only clarification of the `kafka_batch_max_bytes` description. No behavior change.
label: no_change
reason: Negative control. A wording-only rewording of one description, the same diff the negative-property-diff case uses. The generated property reference picks it up on regeneration, so no other page changes. A harness that always flags fails this control.
